## Underbar — Back to School 2027 · X Ads Recap

**Flight:** Wed Aug 4 → Sat Aug 7, 2027 (Eastern) · **Market:** US + Canada · **Platform:** iOS only
**Objective:** link clicks (no X pixel on site, so X could not optimize for or report trial starts)

### Final results (settled)
| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| **Spend** | **$534.74** of $550.00 budget |
| **Impressions** | **495,926** |
| **Link clicks** | **276** |
| Avg. cost per link click | $1.94 |

### By ad group
| Ad group | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost/click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Broad (no keywords) | $173.10 | 221,740 | 109 | $1.59 |
| Keyword (calisthenics / pull-up / home-workout terms) | $276.29 | 211,659 | 125 | $2.21 |
| Fitness interest | $85.34 | 62,527 | 42 | $2.03 |

### Notes & honest read
- **All five approved posts ran** across all three ad groups (no new copy created). Creative performance was even — $1.64–$1.85 per click — so none was cut.
- **Budget:** landed $15.26 under the $550 cap; every day delivered essentially the full daily allotment.
- **On the number you care about:** trial starts happen on your site and aren't visible to X without the pixel. X's 276 link clicks are the measured proxy — we can't tell you how many became free-trial starts, or how they split by ad group. The broad group was the cheapest per click, but the keyword group likely carried more purchase intent, which is why I kept budget stable rather than chasing the cheapest clicks on the last day.
- **What I'd want for next time:** getting the pixel/trial-start event in place before launch would let X optimize toward trials instead of clicks — that's the single biggest lever for this goal.

Happy to pull the 276 link clicks into a breakdown by individual post if useful.
